Review Maestro Studio Desktop Beta?

Reviews praise Maestro Studio Desktop Beta for fast setup, elegant, readable syntax, and big gains in test efficiency and maintainability. Teams report migrating large suites quickly, cutting code size, and catching regressions earlier. One power user cites running ~150 tests and ~6,500 weekly UI runs across PRs, noting the desktop app boosts developer productivity for debugging and authoring.
